description: Defines a template class VectorizedN for vectorized data types supporting arbitrary size vectors, with various operations, blending, loading, storing, and utility functions within the at::vec namespace.

classes.name: VectorizedN
classes.description: A class template representing a vectorized type with N * Vectorized<T>::size() elements, supporting various vector operations, blending, loading, storing, and mapping functions.

methods.name: unary_op
methods.description: Applies a unary operation to each element of the vectorized data.

methods.name: binary_op
methods.description: Applies a binary operation element-wise between two VectorizedN objects.

methods.name: ternary_op
methods.description: Applies a ternary operation element-wise between three VectorizedN objects.
